input.prompt: Clean flat vector infographic for a website, wide landscape composition on a pure white background, corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, matching a light blue and yellow illustration set. Show a five-step mortgage loan pipeline as a single horizontal row of five identical rounded-square tiles with even gutters, connected left to right by short thick periwinkle-blue arrows placed in the gutters between the tiles. All five tiles have exactly the same pale blue #E7F0FB fill with no highlighted, selected, darker or lighter tile, a blue circled step number (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) in the top-left corner, one simple line-and-fill icon centered in the upper two-thirds, and one short bold navy label centered in the lower third, in a clean sans-serif font at a moderate size so every label fits on one line with clear padding. Icons contain no lettering. Tile 1 icon: a loan application form with a pen; label exactly 'Application'. Tile 2 icon: a folder with several documents and a magnifying glass; label exactly 'Documents'. Tile 3 icon: a shield with a green check mark and a small bar chart; label exactly 'Verification'. Tile 4 icon: a clipboard with a checklist and a stamp; label exactly 'Underwriting'. Tile 5 icon: a house with a key and a green check badge; label exactly 'Closing'. Under the row, a slim pale-blue bar spans the full width with a small friendly robot icon at its left end and the words exactly 'Automated with RPA bots' in bold navy centered on it. A single small yellow spark near the top-right corner. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, navy #1F2A44, soft green #3BB273, white. Generous outer margins, crisp edges, no dotted lines. The only text in the image is the five labels, the digits 1 to 5 and the phrase 'Automated with RPA bots', all bold and perfectly spelled.
